## Stream 3 (Gemini Enterprise app) — NO CHANGE since 2026-08-21. Newest date: August 20, 2026.
- Aug 20: **Antigravity for IDEs** available on Standard/Plus/Pay-as-you-go with invoiced billing
  accounts.                                                    [reported 2026-08-21]
- Aug 20: Okta+SCIM autocomplete when sharing; **Google Identity** for third-party data stores via
  external IdPs (OIDC / SAML 2.0).                             [held 2026-08-21]
- Aug 19: subscription seat caps — self-serve 25, invoiced 1,000 per account.   [held]
- Aug 18: new-team-member welcome cards; **Gemini 3.6 Flash GA in the `us` and `eu` multi-regions**
  without allowlist.                                           [held]
- Aug 17: **A2UI + A2A agent registration GA, with A2UI v0.9** (Material Design components)
  alongside v0.8. Customer-hosted, customer-maintained, network-reachable, registered by an admin via
  Cloud console or REST API.                                   [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AISPM]

## Stream 2 (Agent Platform) — nav-only; recovered via WebSearch 2026-08-23
August 2026 carried:
- **Memory Bank `IngestEvents` API GA** — "decouples event ingestion from memory generation, letting
  you continuously stream content to Memory Bank and configure when memory generation is triggered."
  [HELD BELOW THE BAR: the `IngestEvents` path was already named on 2026-08-07 inside the memory-
   profiles finding, the GA cannot be dated to this scan's window, and Google is secondary tier.
   WATCH IT — a continuous streaming ingress into agent memory is the same shape as the AgentCore
   `json` payload finding reported 2026-08-23. If it reappears with a date, report it.]
- **Memory profiles in Memory Bank GA** — already reported 2026-08-07.
- CodeMender model support changed (Gemini 3 Flash removed; 3.5 Flash + 3.1 Pro Preview kept).
- **Agent Studio SSRF fix** in the **auto-generated `/api-proxy` backend endpoint** for web apps
  created before 2026-07-01 — regenerate and redeploy. [A FIX, not an addition, so not reported. But
  note the disclosure: Agent Studio AUTO-GENERATES a backend proxy endpoint in the apps it emits.]
- Grok 4.1 family deprecated / shut down 2026-08-20. [deprecation]
- `execute_tool` / `invoke_connector` trace spans — already reported 2026-08-09.

## Carried forward
Agent Registry governs **Endpoints** as a first-class record type alongside MCP servers, tools and
agents, with an auth manager + bindings; IAM governance policies in private preview
(reported 2026-08-21). Agents API + Agent Studio, SGP engine + Agent Gateway, Model Armor on Agent
Gateway, AI Security Findings dashboard, custom MCP server data stores GA, 17 third-party connectors.

Updated: 2026-08-23 — no movement on stream 3; stream 2 recovered, nothing above the bar.
